title: Yangoupokpi-Lokchao Wildlife Sanctuary
tagline: Untamed Indo-Myanmar Biodiversity Hotspot & Lokchao River Basin

overview.short: Yangoupokpi-Lokchao Wildlife Sanctuary in Manipur is a vital biodiversity corridor on the Indo-Myanmar border, renowned for dense tropical canopies and rare wildlife.
overview.description: Spanning over 184 square kilometres along the Chandel and Tengnoupal border hills, Yangoupokpi-Lokchao Wildlife Sanctuary is one of Manipur’s most biologically diverse nature reserves. Featuring the perennial Lokchao River, dense teak forests, and bamboo thickets, it provides crucial habitat for serow, Himalayan black bear, barking deer, and rare hornbills.

topPlaces.name: Lokchao River Wildlife Corridor
topPlaces.description: The life-giving perennial river that bisects the sanctuary, creating lush riparian habitats where wild boars, sambar, and rare migratory waterfowl gather along boulder-strewn banks.

image.alt: Lokchao River Wildlife Corridor — Yangoupokpi-Lokchao Wildlife Sanctuary, Manipur scenic view

topPlaces.name: Tengnoupal Hill Viewpoint & Ridge
topPlaces.description: The highest mountain pass on the Imphal-Moreh route offering breathtaking 360-degree vistas across the emerald Manipur valley and the distant misty ranges of Myanmar.

image.alt: Tengnoupal Hill Viewpoint & Ridge scenic view in Manipur

topPlaces.name: Moreh Border Town & Friendship Bridge
topPlaces.description: A bustling commercial trading town on the international border with Myanmar, featuring Buddhist pagodas, vibrant Southeast Asian markets, and the historic Friendship Bridge across the border stream.

image.alt: Moreh Border Town & Friendship Bridge scenic view in Manipur

topPlaces.name: Maha Eco Park, Chandel
topPlaces.description: A scenic community-managed eco-park in Chandel set amidst tall pine and oak groves, offering tranquil walking trails, natural water springs, and birdwatching observation points.

image.alt: Maha Eco Park, Chandel scenic view in Manipur

itinerary.title: Day 1 — Core Sanctuary Wildlife & Lokchao River

items.note: Embark on a guided morning safari along the Lokchao river basin to spot serow, barking deer, and endemic birds.
Drive up to the Tengnoupal pass for breathtaking panoramic vistas of the Indo-Myanmar border hills.
Visit the Buddhist pagodas and colorful frontier markets of Moreh town on the international boundary.
Unwind along the peaceful pine-scented nature trails and natural streams of Maha Eco Park.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Yangoupokpi-Lokchao Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: The best time to visit Yangoupokpi-Lokchao Wildlife Sanctuary is Oct – Mar. Summers are 25–42°C and winters are 7–24°C.

faq.q: How do I reach Yangoupokpi-Lokchao Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: The nearest airport is Yangoupokpi-Lokchao Wildlife Sanctuary / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Dimapur Railway Station (184 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.
